summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by RELX PLC containing an AGM trading update for April 2026. The update reaffirms full-year outlook, highlights strong underlying revenue and profit growth across all four business areas (Business Services, Insurance, Scientific Technical Medical, Legal, Exhibitions), and discusses the shift towards AI-enabled analytics and decision tools. It does not announce any M&A, capital returns, restructuring, or other special situation. It is a routine business update typical of a foreign private issuer's ongoing reporting obligations. No deal terms, advisory roles, or structural changes are disclosed. This filing maps to a routine earnings or operational update under US reporting.
